title: Import/Link Framework & Initial Provider Adapters
start_authority: Owner Continue on 2026-08-26 America/Chicago after fresh verification of AIOC main 356fe15b165cfa6e58e0f2c1e77be2bb67717557 and application main 511f9566af10f0defa703350ac4ffa6db0c0c4e7, re-reading AAI-01..05 completion evidence and freshly checking current provider API/terms evidence before resolving the bounded provider-safe import/link, initial-adapter, credential, persistence and exact-head validation contract.
objective: Implement and prove a bounded provider-safe import/link framework and initial adapters that consume completed AAI-02 identities/rights, AAI-03 capability negotiation, AAI-04 playback outcomes and AAI-05 semantic availability without widening rights or gameplay authority.

import_link.local_import_rule: User-owned local import registers caller-selected local content/reference only when reference and ingest rights are explicitly allowed. Any cache/export/record/stream/redistribute/transform operation remains independently rights-gated. File possession never proves license or expanded rights.
import_link.provider_link_rule: Provider link uses only existing AAI-02 identities or caller-supplied non-secret provider identifiers. Linking never implies entitlement, ownership, play rights or copy rights.

rules: credentials supplied ephemerally by caller and excluded from source/receipts
catalog/search/session/playback requests require independent rights/capability/entitlement checks
starter fixture play right unknown remains unavailable despite API capability
provider assets play only through TableTone under current terms
record/stream rights do not create API capability

credentials.rule: Credential material is never stored in repository contracts, deterministic receipts, fixtures or persisted state. Live-capable descriptors accept only opaque runtime credential requirements; CI uses fake transports and no real provider account.

transport.rule: AAI-06 is deterministic request planning plus provider-specific descriptors and injected transports. Validation performs no provider network calls. A live caller must explicitly provide transport/credentials and independently satisfy rights/capability/terms/entitlement gates.

semantic.rule: AAI-05 selected identity is provider-neutral input. Adapters cannot alter semantic ranking, grant rights/capability or silently substitute another provider asset.

terms.rule: Current provider terms/evidence are an independent fail-closed gate. Unsupported, undocumented, provider-contact-required, denied or unknown states cannot be automated or worked around.

persistence.result: No durable AAI-06 canonical persistence required. Import/link plans, provider descriptors and receipts are derived/runtime or caller-owned over existing AAI-02 identities.

nonauthorization: provider audio acquisition/download/copying/caching absent explicit independent rights and authorized path

validation_contract.focused: Prove deterministic local import/provider link/control/manual planning; operation-specific independent rights/capability/terms/entitlement/runtime gates; ephemeral credential boundary; provider restrictions; fake-transport-only validation; no content extraction/copying, gameplay mutation or durable persistence.
validation_contract.predecessors: Run AAI-05, AAI-04, AAI-03, AAI-02 and AAI-01 verifiers plus MIB-11/D18 World-owner regression on both required platforms.
validation_contract.workflow: Register AAI-06 in Repository Health path coverage and self-hosted Validation Core discovery; CI remains provider-account/network independent.
validation_contract.final_gate: Exact candidate head must pass Repository Health, self-hosted Linux and Windows AAI-06 Validation Core, deterministic cross-platform comparison and declared AAI-05/04/03/02/01/World-owner regressions before merge.

preserved_boundaries: AAI-01..05 are completed_verified with no further implementation authority
AAI-06 authority is limited to the resolved provider-safe import/link and initial-adapter contract
rights/provenance, capability, provider terms/entitlement, semantic compatibility and runtime availability remain independent and fail closed
Syrinscape credentials remain caller-supplied runtime-only and no bulk crawling is authorized
TableTone and Pocket Bard remain manual external paths
next_action: Implement only bounded AAI-06 on integration/aai-06-import-link-initial-provider-adapters from application baseline 511f9566af10f0defa703350ac4ffa6db0c0c4e7; add import/link and initial-adapter contracts, deterministic starter scenarios, governed documentation, focused verifier/integration regression and AAI-06 Validation Core wiring; use fake transports in validation and do not add unsupported provider automation, content acquisition/copying/caching, credential persistence, AAI-07 binding or migration 0022.
